AI is helping scientists control an artificial sun at 100 million degrees.

Nuclear fusion could give us clean power. No fossil fuels. The catch? The plasma inside the reactor goes unstable in milliseconds, way faster than any human can react.

So Princeton built an AI called PACMAN. It watches the plasma, predicts trouble and adjusts the machine in real time. And it's already been tested on a real tokamak.

Episode 1 of my AI Breakthroughs series. Follow for episode 2, and send this to someone who's still scared of AI.
